articles.title: UK heatwave live: Met Office issues extreme heat warning as government convenes emergency Cobra meeting
articles.description: Parts of country face fifth heatwave of the summer with highs of 38C forecast this week Parts of the UK will face the fifth heatwave of the summer this week with temperatures forecast to reach highs of 38C , prompting the Met Office to issue an amber weather warning for extreme heat. The record-shattering heatwave has caused wildfires and drought in many parts of the country, with this summer on course to be the UK’s hottest since records began, according to the Met Office. The National Fire Chiefs Council (NFCC) said firefighters have responded to 966 wildfires across England and Wales this year, including 185 in the first 10 days of August alone . The Fire Brigades Union (FBU) general secretary, Steve Wright, told Times Radio the country faces a national emergency “right now”, with wildfires seen “all across” the UK. Continue reading...

articles.title: Country diary: One flower here is thriving, defying the drought | Derek Niemann
articles.description: Frome, Somerset: While other plants are withering or skeletal, tansy is growing in great profusion, and it rewards close observation At first light, the scent of ’76 hangs in the air, a reminder of that endless summer burning itself into autumn, just like this one. I first caught a sniff of it walking home one sweltering evening in the June heatwave and said: “Too soon, too soon.” Now the toasted aroma of spent grass is everywhere – on crispy playing fields, straw village greens, and these scorched tawny meadows of the combe. Scattered groups of cattle have their heads down here. For them I think eating the grass must be like consuming a Pot Noodle before the water is poured in. And then I find the outflow of one of the hillside’s springs. Though it registers nothing more than a seep, it is nevertheless a pocket oasis of comparative lushness, a blessing to a heifer’s eyes. Continue reading...
